title: Roof Replacement in Gladstone, OR
summary: In September 2024, French Roofing replaced the roofs on two outbuildings at a home in Gladstone, OR. The crew tore off the old roofing down to the wood deck, laid synthetic underlayment, and installed new CertainTeed Landmark shingles. The main house roof was in good condition, so it got a cleaning and treatment instead.
scope: Tore off the old roofing on two outbuildings down to the wood deck
Installed synthetic underlayment, painted drip edge and a self-sealing starter course
Installed new CertainTeed Landmark shingles with standard ridge cap
Cleaned and treated the main house roof
Hauled away the debris and ran a magnet over the yard

faqs.question: Why didn't the house get a new roof too?
faqs.answer: The main house roof was in good condition, so it was cleaned and treated while the two outbuildings got new roofs.
